name: drift-d1b-provenance-retest-glm-to-qwen
label: PREREGISTERED on 2026-09-21 before the passages were generated and before any output of this retest existed
question: Was the conjunction failure in D1 (drift 0.00, own-cache control 0.15, text 0.90) a property of the Drift channel on GLM -> Qwen3.8-Flash, or of the prompt and the reader's verbosity? On the MacBook's local Qwen pair the same kind of item reached 0.967 untrained once answers were limited to one sentence.

design.passages: scripts/live/gen_corpus.py --n 110 --seed 9595 --heldout-vocab --require code,person,weight,colour (GLM-written); items built exactly as in D1 (scripts/live/d1_eval.py: conj / sum / hop, up to 20 each, same scoring with must / must_not values)

arms_on_the_same_items.original: the D1 prompts unchanged, 320 new tokens
arms_on_the_same_items.concise: the D1 prompts with ' Answer in one short sentence, giving the value(s) directly.' appended to the question, 96 new tokens

conditions_per_arm: drift (untrained v3 forward translator: stacked3 + fanout3, gain power 1.5)
design.everything_else: as D1: link system prompt, memory appended directly below the reader's own tokens, greedy decoding, Studio drift worker

hypotheses.H1_prompt_bound: conj EM(own_kv, concise) - conj EM(own_kv, original) >= 0.40
hypotheses.H2_drift_keeps_sources_apart: conj EM(drift, concise) >= 0.50 AND conj EM(drift, concise) - conj EM(wrong_memory, concise) >= 0.25
hypotheses.H3_no_cost_elsewhere: pooled EM(drift, concise) >= pooled EM(drift, original)

outcome_labels: CONFIRMED if H1, H2 and H3. PARTLY if H1 only (the reader can separate sources with its own cache, but translated memory still blends). INTERVENTION FAILED if H1 fails: THIS concise-answer wording did not fix source confusion on this pair. That outcome does not show that prompt wording cannot explain the D1 provenance errors, only that this one intervention does not; other wordings, answer formats or reader setups remain untested.
note: the concise wording was chosen on a different model pair and different passages; nothing about it has been tuned on GLM -> Qwen3.8-Flash
independence: This retest uses the untrained v3 forward translator and does not depend on the Studio gradient probe or on Test A; it is run whatever that probe shows.
significance_note: Each item is its own passage pair, so items are independent here; comparisons between the two arms are paired by item (same items, same memories).
amendments: 2026-09-21, before any output of this retest existed (the 110 passages had been generated by GLM but not read; audit feedback): the label REFUTED was replaced by INTERVENTION FAILED with a narrower meaning; independence from Test A stated.
